If you turned President Xi Jinping upside down and shook him, Mauritius would fall out of his pocket. 

We cannot let the UK hand over our shared military base on Diego Garcia to China’s BFF.

Friends in Louisiana: I wanted you to hear about an event my office and our local passport agency are hosting in Lafayette Parish on Thursday, May 21.

I hope it's helpful to any Louisianians who need to apply for or renew their passports ahead of travel plans.

Suicide has become the #2 cause of death for young people. It makes me want to reach for the sick bucket.

I introduced a bill to make sure every student knows they can call the 988 crisis hotline to get help.

Read my latest @TheHill:

thehill.com/opinion/healthca…

This National Police week, I’m proud to honor the courage of our heroes in blue. 

Thank you for all the sacrifices you make to keep our families and communities safe!

Happy Mother’s Day to all the incredible moms in Louisiana and across America!

We appreciate all your hard work and dedication. You make our country great. Thank you!

You have a right to own property in America.

You have a right to own property under Louisiana’s state constitution.

So, if a company wants to build a carbon capture well on your property without your permission in Louisiana, you ought to be able to say NO.

President Obama’s always billed himself as a capitalist.

So why does he have such an affinity for “democratic” socialist Mayor Mamdani?

A democratic socialist is just a socialist who wants to achieve socialism through the ballot box.

Becky and I ask for God’s guidance for the state of Louisiana and our great nation.

Watching Stephen Colbert and President Obama fawn all over each other isn’t my idea of must-see TV.

I think most of America agrees—which is why Colbert's show is losing CBS $40 MILLION a year.

Letting Iran have a nuke is like giving one to Charles Manson.

The world is a much safer place today because America stepped up.

What a ride you had, and we got to watch. Thank you, Mr. Turner.
